description: How an order is going, for the connected person's own order: for a delivery, the stage, minutes remaining, how far the rider is from the drop-off (km) and the rider's first name; for a scheduled pre-order, its time slot, ready time (in the venue's local time) and what is due in advance; for other orders, the status. The rider's phone number and exact location are never returned.

orderCode.description: The order code returned when the order was placed, e.g. WA-K4M2

restaurantId.description: The venue the order was placed at (needed with orderCode if the person has the same code at two venues)

name: track_order
title: Track an order
